YOUR OWN PRIVATE AMPHITHEATER.
The top is down. The sun is glistening. But even with outside noise, your tunes are crisp and clear. That’s because in Club and
Grand Touring models, the Bose® Premium Sound System creates an individual sonic experience. With 9 speakers, including two
45mm UltraNearfield™ speakers positioned in each of the MX-5’s headrests, sound is as clear as day. From bass to treble, audiophiles
can enjoy pure sound quality from their MP3s through two USB audio inputs. Only the roar of the MX-5’s engine will penetrate the
cabin thanks to Bose® AudioPilot® 2 Noise Compensation Technology. Now unwanted noise is left where it belongs—outside.
